verdict.rationale: Deel is a workforce/payroll SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant host; all evidence describes Deel exposing its own MCP server so external agents (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) can call Deel's tools, which is the opposite direction from this story of plugging external MCP servers into Deel itself. There is no evidence of any Deel-side agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client consuming other servers' tools, making this axis a category mismatch for this product.
